title: AuthoredIntent
description: A design requirement — the top of the three representations. Stores intent and acceptance ranges, NOT parameters. The engine compares these against what canonical parameters actually produce in simulation, and attributes regressions to a transaction: 'requirement says 130-152px; params produce 91px; tx_84 introduced it.'

examples: Jump should peak around a character height and feel floaty but responsive.

requirements.description: Named acceptance criteria. Ranges are [min,max] inclusive; a bare value is an equality/boolean assertion.

verified_by.description: Test ids that assert this requirement against a run.

examples.statement: An attack only lands on the half the fighter is turned toward. No blind-side hits.
Same height as the old jump but much floatier — the arc the playtester dialed in on F1.
